a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells first means we'd almost certainly both be caught short. So I'm departing from the agreement and taking 4 cells in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather operate afterward, I'll operate with you in later rounds to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take any more.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry to break the plan. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs for you, and I won't take anything more.
